dataList.content: It is dark. Like an unlit cinema.
Only now does the sensation become palpable. The Golden Bough lies both without and within this place.
Though this place does not physically exist, from that perfect mirror image... the same, real radiance streams through.
And the sun... and its light... shines upon us.
<color=#bf1a42>... Fascinating. You can convey your will to the Grand Magasin, even as someone who isn't a Giant?</color>
<color=#bf1a42>But ma puce, I don't think that'll—</color>
Listen to what you feel from within.
And tell me what it says.
